messages:
maria: Heads-up — I noticed a spike in 'unknown' credit attributions during yesterday's ratelimit event. looks like 5-8% of tokens lost provenance. anyone tracking this?
cheng: saw it in the debug logs. sampling kicked in and our provenance chain got truncated in the compact path.
sam: which component lost the chain? shard, fanout, or finalizer?
dena: pre-finalizer join. compacting proof frames collapsed some intermediate refs. collision-ish, not DB corruption.
ops-bot: :warning: ingest-lag alert for shard-12: 6m backlog (auto-mitigate engaged)
maria: ok. we need a clear tradeoff: strong provenance (no data loss, higher throughput cost) vs. eventual (smaller index, potential audit gaps).
cheng: strong path would mean keeping full fingerprint chains in the fast index and never dropping until finalization — storage + latency up. eventual path lets us GC aggressively but loses fine-grained ownership for a window.
sam: idea: per-tenant SLO tiers. premium tenants flow through strong path, others through compact path with sampled proofs. hybrid reduces overall cost.
dena: also think about making the compact frames self-proofing: include a tiny chain signature so we can rehydrate even if intermediate refs are GC'd. that buys audits without fully hindering GC.
maria: can you sketch the self-proof idea?
dena: short version: each compact frame stores {root_fp, epoch, delta_proof}, where delta_proof is a small merkle-ish accumulator. rehydrate job fetches nearby frames and verifies root. cheap to store.
cheng: prototype snippet i tossed in my branch: ```
// compute short fp
short_fp = sha256(prefix || tenant_id || seq)[:8]
frame.sig = hmac(key, short_fp || epoch)
```
sam: Nice. but careful: 8 bytes collision rate ~ 1 in 2^64 -> ok for sampling but not for legal audits. make configurable per-tenant.
maria: good call. if premium needs cryptographic non-repudiation, we keep full 32B root hashes. others default to short fp.
ops-bot: note: this change will affect the recon tool and the chargeback lambda. plan for a migration window.
cheng: migration plan: write dual-writes for 2 weeks (both full chain and compact frame). then run backfill rehydrate to ensure compacts can be validated.
sam: i'll add integration tests that simulate GC and rehydrate run. will also add a metric: rehydrate-success-rate per-tenant.
dena: can we avoid a synchronous fallback that adds p99 latency? prefer async rehydrate with best-effort charge correction and alerting.
maria: agreed. async corrections + auditable exceptions for premium. i'll file an RFC PR with the hybrid design and migration plan. assign cheng + sam for prototype. dena to draft rehydrate verifier.
cheng: putting a short spike on my calendar today.
sam: i'll wire up CI tests after your branch shows up.
dena: i'll draft the verifier doc and include perf knobs.
maria: thanks all. action items summarized in the RFC. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-7894 for migration work (linked in thread).
